Copied unmodified from Amy's scifi-ui library on 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-20,
at commit 43857a2 (2026-09-15):

  https://github.com/amyleesterling/scifi-ui

  hologram.css        the main set: the holoframe with its HUD corner
                      brackets, the panel and readout surfaces, tokens at
                      the top (site.css redefines the tokens for this
                      site's palette; the file itself is untouched)
  hologram-tap.js     the tap layer that puts .holo-on on anything with a
                      hover treatment, so the brackets are reachable on a
                      screen with no pointer. The library's rule: load it
                      on any page that loads any part of the library.
  panel-surface.css   .holopanel, the dark gradient panel with the lit top
                      hairline and the materialise entrance (is-in)
  converge-swarm.css  the canvas the swarm draws on (components/ upstream)
  converge-swarm.js   holoconverge(host, target): particles stream in from
                      the host's edges and gather on the target
                      (components/ upstream)

Consumers: the generated sci-fi pages (scifi.html loads all five;
scifi-civ.html loads hologram.css and panel-surface.css). The default
pages, index.html and civ.html (the atlas, ink on paper), load only the
swarm, whose three tints they set to ink through the --holo-* tokens in
atlas.css. The polity card (#tip) is built on .holopanel and
.holoframe, carries the frame's four HUD brackets, plays the materialise
each time it opens (js/app.js adds is-in) and, as it arrives, a short
burst of the converge swarm gathering on its name (js/app.js starts it
and stops it after about a second and a half). The map key, the notice,
the hint, the search panel and the card page's hero, ending and period
boxes are .holopanel surfaces; the brand is a .holounder. site.css
redefines the tokens for this palette, with no warm accent at all: Amy's
rule is no orange anywhere.

Do not edit these files. To upgrade, copy the same five down from a newer
commit and update the commit above. Licence: see the repository.
